sentences.text: Leanne Marsh (S2) stated she is doing art, specifically a big painting of her cat, Biscuit.
Leanne Marsh (S2) stated she cooks on Mondays and goes to the disco on Fridays.
Leanne Marsh (S2) stated she lives with her mum at home and helps her with hoovering because her mum's knees are bad.
Leanne Marsh (S2) stated she sometimes does travel training and wants to get the bus on her own to town.
Leanne Marsh (S2) stated she currently travels to the centre via a minibus.
Leanne Marsh (S2) stated she does not like Dave, who drives the minibus.
Leanne Marsh (S2) disclosed that Dave touched her on her chest while she was getting off the minibus outside her house.
Leanne Marsh (S2) disclosed that Dave touched her between her legs over her trousers.
Leanne Marsh (S2) initially stated she was 'telling stories' about the incident, then corrected herself to say it is true.
Leanne Marsh (S2) disclosed that Dave kissed her on her mouth and told her it was their secret and not to tell her mum.
Leanne Marsh (S2) stated that Dave touches her every week when she is the last person on the bus.
Leanne Marsh (S2) stated the abuse started after the summer, following her birthday in August.
Leanne Marsh (S2) stated that none of the staff at Brookside have touched her like that, and only Dave has done so.
Leanne Marsh (S2) stated she is not in trouble and that Dave should not have done what he did.
Leanne Marsh (S2) stated she would like her mum told about the abuse.
Leanne Marsh (S2) stated she prefers to take a taxi rather than her mum driving her, because her mum's knees are bad.
Social worker Angela Okafor (S1) stated she will ring the safeguarding team and the police today.
Social worker Angela Okafor (S1) stated she will talk to Joanne, the centre manager, to arrange a taxi from tomorrow, Wednesday.
Social worker Angela Okafor (S1) stated she will come to Leanne Marsh's house tomorrow at 4 o'clock to tell her mum together.
Social worker Angela Okafor (S1) stated she will ask Sue to set up two practice bus trips into town in December.
Social worker Angela Okafor (S1) stated she will bring Leanne Marsh something easy-read about what happens next.
